name: Turnstone
summary: Free Mac app for persistent AI agents that run on the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok subscription you already pay for.
description: Turnstone is a macOS app for persistent AI agents with local memory you can open and correct. It runs on the AI subscription or API key you already have (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok) and can switch models when a limit is hit; prepaid Turnstone Credits are available if you have no key. The Mac app is free forever, with no card required for the Chief of Staff and free app connectors. Teams under 10 are offered 30 days free, as stated on the site.
